人机交互.title: A Framework of User Experience Principles for Human-AI Agent Interaction in the Workplace
人机交互.title_zh: 工作场所人-AI代理交互的用户体验原则框架
人机交互.summary: As AI agents become integral to business workflows, establishing guiding user experience (UX) principles is crucial for ensuring user trust and successful adoption. To address this, our study uses a multi-method approach - combining participatory design workshop, paper-and-pencil, expert review, met
人机交互.summary_zh: 随着AI代理成为业务流程不可或缺的一部分，建立指导性的用户体验（UX）原则对于确保用户信任和成功采用至关重要。本研究采用多方法途径——结合参与式设计研讨会、纸笔测试、专家评审等方法，提出了一个针对工作场所人-AI代理交互的UX原则框架。创新点在于系统性地整合了用户参与和专家意见，为设计可信赖的AI代理提供了实用指南。主要贡献是填补了该领域缺乏统一UX原则的空白，有助于提升AI代理在企业中的接受度和效能。

机器人.title: Closing the Lab-to-Store Gap: A Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning VLA Framework for Retail Humanoids
机器人.title_zh: 缩小实验室到商店的差距：面向零售机器人的数据高效后训练与经验驱动学习VLA框架
机器人.summary: Closing the gap between benchmark performance and reliable real-world operation remains a central challenge for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) humanoid robots, which must handle execution errors, distribution shifts, and environmental variability. This paper presents DEED (Data-Efficient Post-Training
机器人.summary_zh: 缩小基准性能与可靠现实操作之间的差距仍然是视觉-语言-动作（VLA）人形机器人的核心挑战，它们必须处理执行错误、分布偏移和环境变化。本文提出了DEED（数据高效后训练）框架，通过后训练和经验驱动学习，使得零售人形机器人能够高效适应真实场景。创新点在于结合了数据高效的微调策略和基于经验的在线学习，显著降低了部署所需的数据量。主要贡献是提出了一种实用的方法，加速了人形机器人从实验室到商店的转化，提升了其鲁棒性和适应性。

机器人.title: Courteous Anticipation: Improving Long-Lived Task Planning in Persistent Shared Environments
机器人.title_zh: 礼貌性预见：提升持久共享环境中的长期任务规划
机器人.summary: We consider a task planning scenario in which robots sharing a persistent environment are assigned tasks one at a time from a held-out sequence. Standard task planners, lacking foresight of future tasks and inconsiderate of others' constraints, solve each task in isolation, leaving terminal states t
机器人.summary_zh: 本文考虑机器人在持久共享环境中按顺序被分配任务的任务规划场景。标准任务规划器缺乏对未来任务的预见且不考虑他人约束，孤立求解每个任务，导致终端状态影响后续任务。创新点在于引入“礼貌性预见”机制，使机器人提前考虑未来任务和他人约束，优化长期任务执行效率。主要贡献是提出了一种协同规划框架，显著提升了共享环境下的任务完成质量。

大语言模型.title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Selective Evidence Adoption from Contaminated Retrieval Results
大语言模型.title_zh: 基于强化学习的大型语言模型从污染检索结果中选择性采纳证据
大语言模型.summary: Retrieval-augmented large language models frequently face contexts that interleave useful evidence with misleading statements or instruction-like content. Blanket refusal discards valid evidence, whereas uncritical adoption yields incorrect or unsafe answers. The ability to selectively adopt relevant
大语言模型.summary_zh: 检索增强的大型语言模型经常面临有用证据与误导性陈述或指令式内容交织的上下文。全面拒绝会丢弃有效证据，而不加批判地采纳则会导致错误或不安全的答案。本文提出利用强化学习来训练模型选择性采纳相关证据，从而在保证安全性的同时最大化信息利用。创新点在于将证据采纳建模为序列决策问题，并通过奖励信号引导模型识别并过滤污染内容。主要贡献是提高了检索增强LLM在复杂环境下的鲁棒性和可靠性，减少了幻觉和错误。

大语言模型.title: Small, Free, and Effective: Orchestrating Open-Weight Small Language Models to Outperform Single LLM for Malware Analysis
大语言模型.title_zh: 小巧、免费且高效：编排开源小语言模型在恶意软件分析中超越单个大语言模型
大语言模型.summary: Malware analysis demands rapid interpretation of complex detonation reports spanning filesystem, network, and process behaviours. While large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities for technical artifact interpretation, the opacity and escalating API costs of closed-weight fronti
大语言模型.summary_zh: 恶意软件分析需要快速解读涵盖文件系统、网络和进程行为的复杂引爆报告。虽然大语言模型（LLM）在技术工件解读方面展现出令人印象深刻的能力，但闭源前沿模型的封闭性和不断上升的API成本阻碍了其广泛应用。本文提出一种编排多个开源小语言模型（SLM）的框架，通过协同工作以超越单个LLM的性能。创新点在于利用模型集成和任务分解策略，使多个小模型各司其职，在恶意软件分析任务上达到或超过GPT-4等大模型的效果，同时保持低成本和高解释性。

大语言模型.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
大语言模型.title_zh: SLAI T-Rex：在昇腾SuperPOD上对DeepSeek-V4系列进行全参数后训练
大语言模型.summary: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are optimized for NVIDIA GPUs, we present SLAI T-Rex, a system designed for the Ascend SuperPOD cluster. We propose a series of optimizations: (1) a hybrid parallelism strategy combining expert parallelism with tensor parallelism; (2) a memory-efficient offloading mechanism; (3) a communication-computation overlap scheduler. We evaluate on the DeepSeek-V4 family with up to 1 trillion parameters, achieving 55% model FLOPs utilization (MFU) and 1.5x speedup over baseline training. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of training large MoE models on non-NVIDIA hardware, providing a blueprint for heterogeneous AI infrastructure.
大语言模型.summary_zh: 万亿参数规模的MoE模型的全参数后训练给大规模分布式训练带来了严峻的系统级挑战，包括严重的内存压力、非重叠的通信开销和低效的内核执行。虽然大多数大规模LLM训练系统针对NVIDIA GPU进行了优化，但我们提出了SLAI T-Rex，一个专为昇腾SuperPOD集群设计的系统。我们提出了一系列优化：(1) 结合专家并行和张量并行的混合并行策略；(2) 内存高效的卸载机制；(3) 通信-计算重叠调度器。我们在参数高达1万亿的DeepSeek-V4系列上进行了评估，实现了55%的模型FLOPs利用率（MFU），并且相对于基线训练获得了1.5倍的加速。我们的工作证明了在非NVIDIA硬件上训练大型MoE模型的可行性，为异构AI基础设施提供了蓝图。

大语言模型.title: PoTRE: Test-Time Reasoning inspired by Cognitive Heterogeneity
大语言模型.title_zh: PoTRE：受认知异质性启发的测试时推理
大语言模型.summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at many tasks, they frequently struggle with complex reasoning that requires long-horizon planning and iterative error correction. Furthermore, standard single-stream prompting proves brittle when models encounter novel abstractions or rigorous domain constraints. This paper proposes PoTRE, a test-time reasoning framework inspired by cognitive heterogeneity, which leverages multiple reasoning pathways and adaptive selection to improve robustness and accuracy on complex tasks. Experiments show significant improvements over baselines on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks.
大语言模型.summary_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在许多任务上表现出色，但它们经常在需要长期规划和迭代纠错的复杂推理中遇到困难。此外，标准单流提示在模型遇到新颖抽象或严格领域约束时显得脆弱。本文提出PoTRE，一种受认知异质性启发的测试时推理框架，利用多条推理路径和自适应选择来提高复杂任务的鲁棒性和准确性。实验表明，在数学和逻辑推理基准上，该方法显著优于基线。

自然语言处理.title: TINY_SCHILLER: A Drop-In German Drama Corpus for Small Language Models
自然语言处理.title_zh: TINY_SCHILLER：面向小型语言模型的即插用德语戏剧语料库
自然语言处理.summary: tiny_schiller closes the small-language-model prototyping, fine-tuning, education, and research gap for German literary text, providing a single-file, drop-in counterpart to Karpathy's tiny_shakespeare. The available German literary corpora are larger and richer, but require parser engineering before
自然语言处理.summary_zh: tiny_schiller填补了德语文学文本在小语言模型原型设计、微调、教育和研究方面的空白，提供了与Karpathy的tiny_shakespeare对应的单文件即插用资源。现有的德语文学语料库更大更丰富，但需要解析器工程才能使用。创新点在于构建了一个轻量级、易用的德语戏剧语料库，降低了研究门槛。主要贡献是为小型语言模型在德语文学领域的应用提供了标准化基准，促进了相关教育和研究。

自然语言处理.title: Sound Probabilistic Safety Bounds for Large Language Models
自然语言处理.title_zh: 大型语言模型的可靠概率安全界限
自然语言处理.summary: We propose a novel framework for computing rigorous bounds on the probability that a large language model (LLM) generates harmful output to a given prompt. We study a new application of the Clopper-Pearson confidence intervals to obtain probably approximately correct (PAC) bounds for this problem. The framework provides sound statistical guarantees, enabling safety verification of LLMs. Experiments on several LLMs demonstrate that the bounds are tight and computationally feasible, offering a practical tool for LLM safety assessment.
自然语言处理.summary_zh: 我们提出一个新颖框架，用于计算大型语言模型（LLM）对给定提示生成有害输出的概率的严格界限。我们研究了Clopper-Pearson置信区间在该问题上的新应用，以获得可能近似正确（PAC）界限。该框架提供可靠的统计保证，实现LLM的安全性验证。在多个LLM上的实验表明，界限紧且计算可行，为LLM安全评估提供了实用工具。

自然语言处理.title: When Does Knowledge Distillation Hurt? Reliability-Aware Distillation for Low-Resource Language Summarization
自然语言处理.title_zh: 知识蒸馏何时有害？低资源语言摘要的可靠性感知蒸馏
自然语言处理.summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a standard approach for compressing sequence-to-sequence models, but its per-sample effects are rarely examined. On the BanSum Bangla summarization benchmark, we find that standard KD improves ROUGE-L by only +0.0003 over a cross-entropy baseline, and that approximately 40% of training samples actually suffer from distillation, i.e., the student model performs worse than if trained without KD. We propose a reliability-aware distillation method that identifies and down-weights harmful samples during training, achieving consistent improvements across multiple low-resource languages. Our analysis reveals that samples where the teacher is uncertain or where the student already performs well are most likely to be harmed by KD.
自然语言处理.summary_zh: 知识蒸馏（KD）是压缩序列到序列模型的标准方法，但其逐样本效应很少被研究。在BanSum孟加拉语摘要基准上，我们发现标准KD相比交叉熵基线仅提升了0.0003的ROUGE-L，并且大约40%的训练样本实际上因蒸馏而受损，即学生模型的表现比不使用KD时更差。我们提出了一种可靠性感知蒸馏方法，在训练过程中识别并降低有害样本的权重，在多个低资源语言上实现了一致的改进。我们的分析表明，教师模型不确定或学生模型已表现良好的样本最容易受到KD的伤害。

人工智能.title: TRUST-ESD: A Risk-Calibrated and Governance-Aware AI Framework for Enterprise Strategic Decision Support Under Uncertainty
人工智能.title_zh: TRUST-ESD：面向不确定性下企业战略决策支持的风险校准与治理感知AI框架
人工智能.summary: Enterprise strategic decision support requires AI systems that are not only accurate, but also uncertainty-aware, risk-calibrated, explainable, and governance-compliant. This paper proposes TRUST-ESD, a risk-calibrated and governance-aware framework for enterprise decision support under uncertainty.
人工智能.summary_zh: 企业战略决策支持需要AI系统不仅准确，还要具有不确定性感知、风险校准、可解释性和治理合规性。本文提出了TRUST-ESD，一个面向不确定性下企业决策支持的风险校准与治理感知框架。创新点在于将风险量化与治理约束融入决策过程，确保输出既可靠又符合规范。主要贡献是提供了一个综合框架，增强了AI在企业战略决策中的可信度和实用性，推动了负责任的AI应用。

NLP.title: The Maskability Index: Predicting Task-Objective Alignment in Pretrained Language Models
NLP.title_zh: 掩码性指数：预测预训练语言模型中任务-目标对齐
NLP.summary: Large-scale pretrained language models such as T5 and BERT have demonstrated strong capabilities for generating structured knowledge. However, their performance depends on how closely the prompting strategy matches the objectives used during pretraining. We introduce the Maskability Index (MI), a quantitative measure to predict the alignment between a downstream task and the pretraining objective of masked language models. MI is computed by analyzing the proportion of tokens that can be masked without altering task semantics. Experiments on multiple tasks show that MI strongly correlates with task performance, enabling efficient task selection and prompt design without full model fine-tuning.
NLP.summary_zh: 大规模预训练语言模型（如T5和BERT）在生成结构化知识方面展现出强大能力，但其性能高度依赖于提示策略与预训练目标的匹配程度。本文提出掩码性指数（Maskability Index, MI），一种用于预测下游任务与掩码语言模型预训练目标对齐程度的定量指标。MI通过分析在不改变任务语义的前提下可被掩码的令牌比例计算得出。在多项任务上的实验表明，MI与任务性能高度相关，从而无需完整微调模型即可实现高效的任务选择和提示设计。

NLP.title: Generative AI floods and dilutes the market for books
NLP.title_zh: 生成式AI充斥并稀释了图书市场
NLP.summary: Generative AI can produce book-length works of fiction at near-zero cost. These books are often dismissed as low-quality ``slop'' that buyers will ignore, and are assumed to carry little commercial weight. We test that assumption with full-text AI detection across 14,419 self-published genre-fiction
NLP.summary_zh: 生成式AI能以近乎零成本生产长篇虚构作品。这些书籍常被视作低质量的“垃圾”，认为买家会忽略且商业价值极低。本文通过对14,419本自出版类型小说的全文AI检测，验证了这一假设。研究发现，AI生成的书籍在市场上占据显著份额，且价格竞争导致人类作者收入下降。该工作首次量化了AI对图书市场的冲击，揭示了AI生成内容对创意产业的潜在威胁，呼吁建立内容溯源和监管机制。

NLP.title: Language-Specific versus Cross-Lingual Knowledge Graphs for Implicit Aspect Identification in Arabic: A Comparative Study of Reasoning and Adaptation Strategies
NLP.title_zh: 面向阿拉伯语隐式方面识别的语言特定与跨语言知识图谱：推理与适应策略的比较研究
NLP.summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) in Arabic must recover both explicitly stated aspects and implicit aspects that are never named in the text. Implicit identification typically relies on an auxiliary knowledge source (e.g., a knowledge graph (KG)) linking opinion cues to aspect categories, but
NLP.summary_zh: 阿拉伯语方面级情感分析需要恢复显式提及和文本中未命名的隐式方面。隐式识别通常依赖辅助知识源（如知识图谱）将观点线索与方面类别关联。本文比较了语言特定与跨语言知识图谱在隐式方面识别中的效果，研究了推理与适应策略。创新点在于系统评估了不同知识图谱构建方式对阿拉伯语隐式方面识别的影响，主要贡献是揭示了跨语言知识图谱在低资源场景下的优势。

NLP.title: On the Systematic Challenges of Culturally Loaded Machine Translation: Dream of the Red Chamber as the Cultural Lens
NLP.title_zh: 文化负载机器翻译的系统性挑战：以《红楼梦》为文化透镜
NLP.summary: Culturally loaded translation poses unique challenges for machine translation (MT), as meanings are deeply embedded in socio-cultural contexts beyond surface linguistic forms. Although large language models (LLMs) have enabled MT systems to achieve human-like quality in many scenarios, their ability to handle culturally loaded texts remains limited. This paper uses the Chinese classic 'Dream of the Red Chamber' as a lens to systematically analyze these challenges, identifying issues such as loss of cultural connotations, inconsistency in translating culturally specific terms, and difficulty in conveying implicit social norms. The study provides a taxonomy of cultural translation problems and evaluates several LLM-based MT systems, revealing significant gaps in cultural understanding. The authors propose a framework for improving culturally aware MT by integrating external knowledge and context-aware decoding.
NLP.summary_zh: 文化负载翻译对机器翻译（MT）构成独特挑战，因为意义深植于社会文化语境中，超越表面语言形式。尽管大语言模型（LLM）使MT系统在许多场景下达到类人质量，但其处理文化负载文本的能力仍有限。本文以中国经典《红楼梦》为透镜，系统分析这些挑战，识别出文化内涵丢失、文化特定术语翻译不一致、隐含社会规范传达困难等问题。研究提供了文化翻译问题的分类法，并评估了多个基于LLM的MT系统，揭示出文化理解方面的显著差距。作者提出了一个通过整合外部知识和上下文感知解码来改进文化感知MT的框架。

强化学习/RL.title: Coordinating from Memory: Graph-Structured Experience Reuse for Multi-Agent Adaptation in Dynamic Manufacturing
强化学习/RL.title_zh: 基于记忆的协调：动态制造中多智能体适应的图结构经验复用
强化学习/RL.summary: Dynamic manufacturing environments require multi-agent systems to coordinate effectively under frequent operational disturbances such as machine failures, urgent job arrivals, and processing time variations. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches treat each disturbance episode independently, leading to sample inefficiency and poor generalization. We propose a graph-structured experience reuse framework that stores and retrieves past successful coordination strategies as graphs. Agents learn to adapt by retrieving relevant experiences from a memory buffer and reusing them to accelerate learning. Experiments on a simulated manufacturing benchmark show significant improvements in sample efficiency and adaptation speed compared to baselines.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 动态制造环境要求多智能体系统在频繁的操作干扰（如机器故障、紧急订单到达和加工时间变化）下有效协调。现有的多智能体强化学习方法将每个干扰事件独立处理，导致样本效率低下和泛化能力差。本文提出一种图结构经验复用框架，将过去成功的协调策略以图形式存储和检索。智能体通过从记忆缓冲区检索相关经验并加以复用来加速学习。在模拟制造基准上的实验表明，与基线相比，该方法在样本效率和适应速度上均有显著提升。

强化学习/RL.title: JANUS: Foreseeing Latent Risk for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
强化学习/RL.title_zh: JANUS：预见长周期智能体安全的潜在风险
强化学习/RL.summary: Agent safety is moving from content moderation toward preventing operational failures before tool-using agents act. We propose Janus, a foresight-oriented framework for long-horizon agent safety that trains guards to anticipate delayed risks from partial trajectories. Janus synthesizes diverse agent
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 智能体安全正从内容审核转向预防工具使用智能体在行动前的操作失败。本文提出Janus，一个面向长周期智能体安全的预见性框架，训练守卫从部分轨迹中预测延迟风险。Janus综合了多种智能体行为，通过前瞻性风险评估，显著提升了长期任务中的安全性，创新点在于将风险预测提前至行动之前，主要贡献是构建了可学习的风险预见机制。

强化学习/RL.title: Drift-Aware RL-based Wavelet Denoising for Network-Traffic Anomaly Detection
强化学习/RL.title_zh: 基于漂移感知强化学习的小波去噪用于网络流量异常检测
强化学习/RL.summary: Traffic-utilisation measurements for network monitoring are corrupted by additive noise and statistical drift: time-dependent change in the signal's mean, variance, distributional shape, or tail behaviour. Static wavelet denoising, calibrated under stationary independent and identically distributed assumptions, fails under drift. This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that adaptively selects wavelet denoising parameters in response to detected drift. The RL agent learns a policy to adjust thresholds and decomposition levels dynamically, improving anomaly detection accuracy. Experimental results on real-world network traces show significant improvement over static methods.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 网络监控中的流量利用率测量受到加性噪声和统计漂移（信号均值、方差、分布形状或尾部行为随时间变化）的污染。静态小波去噪在平稳独立同分布假设下校准，但在漂移情况下失效。本文提出一种强化学习（RL）框架，根据检测到的漂移自适应选择小波去噪参数。RL智能体学习策略以动态调整阈值和分解级别，提高异常检测精度。在真实网络流量数据上的实验表明，相比静态方法有显著提升。创新点在于将RL与漂移感知结合，实现小波去噪的在线自适应。

大语言模型/LLM.title: The Ethics of Autonomous AI Agents for Offensive Security
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 用于攻击性安全的自主AI智能体伦理
大语言模型/LLM.summary: LLM-driven autonomous agents are reshaping offensive security. Unlike traditional penetration-testing tooling -- deterministic, narrowly scoped, and operated by trained practitioners -- agentic security tools exhibit indeterminacy along three independent dimensions. First, their actions are non-deterministic due to LLM stochasticity. Second, their scope is broad and emergent. Third, they can operate autonomously without human intervention. This raises ethical concerns regarding accountability, misuse, and unintended harm. We analyze these dimensions and propose guidelines for responsible development and deployment of such agents, emphasizing transparency, human oversight, and fail-safe mechanisms.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大语言模型驱动的自主智能体正在重塑攻击性安全领域。与传统渗透测试工具（确定性、范围狭窄、由训练有素的从业者操作）不同，智能安全工具在三个独立维度上表现出不确定性：首先，由于LLM的随机性，其行动是非确定性的；其次，其范围广泛且具有涌现性；第三，它们可以在无需人工干预的情况下自主运行。这引发了关于责任归属、滥用和意外伤害的伦理问题。本文分析了这些维度，并提出了负责任开发和部署此类智能体的指南，强调透明度、人类监督和故障安全机制。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Co-Evolving LLM Evaluators and Policies via DynamicRubric
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 通过DynamicRubric实现LLM评估器与策略的协同进化
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Post-training with evaluator feedback on policy-induced samples serves as a major mechanism for improving large language models. As policies improve, these sampled responses become close in quality. These close candidates create a bottleneck for policy optimization: collapsed relative evaluator scor
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 基于评估器对策略生成样本反馈的后训练是改进大语言模型的主要机制。随着策略提升，采样响应质量趋于接近，导致评估器相对分数差异变小，形成策略优化瓶颈。本文提出DynamicRubric，一种动态评估标准框架，使评估器与策略协同进化：评估器根据当前策略水平自动调整评分标准，保持区分度；策略则利用这些精细化反馈持续优化。实验证明，该方法在多个基准上显著提升了模型性能，避免了传统固定评估标准下的性能停滞，为LLM后训练提供了新范式。

大语言模型/LLM.title: ELSAA: Efficient Low-Rank and Sparse Attention Approximation for Training Transformers
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: ELSAA：用于训练Transformer的高效低秩与稀疏注意力近似
大语言模型/LLM.summary: The quadratic $N\times N$ attention score matrix remains a central obstacle to extending Transformers to longer input lengths. Existing efficient attention methods usually reduce this bottleneck by either imposing sparsity, so that each query attends to only a small subset of keys, or by using low-r
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 二次复杂度注意力矩阵是扩展Transformer至更长输入的核心障碍。现有高效注意力方法通常通过施加稀疏性（每个查询仅关注少量键）或使用低秩近似来缓解瓶颈。本文提出ELSAA，结合低秩与稀疏注意力近似，在训练中实现高效计算。创新点在于混合策略，既保持表达能力又降低复杂度。主要贡献是提出了一种可训练的近似方法，在长序列任务中达到与全注意力相当的性能，同时显著减少内存和计算开销。

大语言模型/LLM.title: MOF-Sleuth: Tool-Grounded Reward Alignment for Explainable Fine-Grained MOF CIF Auditing
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: MOF-Sleuth：基于工具奖励对齐的可解释细粒度MOF CIF审计
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large metal-organic framework (MOF) databases support simulation, screening, and machine learning through crystallographic information files (CIFs). Subtle chemical and structural errors in these inputs can compromise downstream results and hinder manual inspection. LLM advances in computational chemistry offer potential for automated auditing, but they often lack domain-specific precision. We introduce MOF-Sleuth, a framework that leverages LLMs with tool-grounded reward alignment to detect and explain errors in MOF CIFs. By integrating external chemical tools and reinforcement learning from human feedback, MOF-Sleuth achieves fine-grained error detection and provides clear explanations. Experiments show significant improvements over baselines in accuracy and interpretability.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大型金属有机框架（MOF）数据库通过晶体学信息文件（CIF）支持模拟、筛选和机器学习。这些输入中的微小化学和结构错误可能影响下游结果并阻碍人工检查。LLM在计算化学方面的进展为自动审计提供了潜力，但往往缺乏领域特定的精度。本文提出MOF-Sleuth框架，利用LLM结合工具奖励对齐来检测和解释MOF CIF中的错误。通过整合外部化学工具和基于人类反馈的强化学习，MOF-Sleuth实现了细粒度错误检测并提供了清晰的解释。实验表明，在准确性和可解释性方面相比基线有显著提升。

大语言模型/LLM.title: PRO-LONG: Programmatic Memory Enables Long-Horizon Reasoning
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: PRO-LONG：编程记忆实现长时域推理
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Long-horizon tasks require sustained perception, reasoning, and exploration, and are a persistent challenge for large language model (LLM) agents. This gap is reflected in their limited performance on continual learning benchmarks such as ARC-AGI-3, especially when models are evaluated out of the box. This paper introduces PRO-LONG, a framework that combines programmatic memory with LLM agents. Programmatic memory stores structured knowledge and reasoning steps in a code-like format, enabling precise retrieval and composition. The agent writes and executes programs to solve long-horizon tasks. Experiments show significant improvement on ARC-AGI-3 and other reasoning benchmarks.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 长时域任务需要持续的感知、推理和探索，对大型语言模型（LLM）智能体而言是持续挑战。这一差距体现在它们在持续学习基准（如ARC-AGI-3）上的性能有限，尤其是当模型未经微调直接评估时。本文提出PRO-LONG框架，将编程记忆与LLM智能体结合。编程记忆以类代码格式存储结构化知识和推理步骤，实现精确检索与组合。智能体通过编写和执行程序来解决长时域任务。实验表明，在ARC-AGI-3及其他推理基准上取得显著提升。创新点在于引入编程记忆作为外部结构化存储，增强LLM的长期推理能力。

大语言模型/LLM.title: EvoThink: Evolving Thinking in Large Reasoning Models via Self-Pruning and Aha-Moment Preference Optimization
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: EvoThink：通过自我剪枝和“啊哈时刻”偏好优化进化大型推理模型的思维
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often suffer from overthinking due to redundant verification steps. Existing approaches for mitigating overthinking, such as fast-slow thinking switching and reasoning trajectory compression, fail to make a fine-grained distinction between beneficial and redundant steps. In this paper, we propose EvoThink, a framework that evolves LRMs' reasoning process by integrating self-pruning and Aha-Moment Preference Optimization (APO). Self-pruning dynamically removes redundant reasoning steps during inference, while APO uses reinforcement learning to encourage the model to produce concise yet accurate reasoning paths. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that EvoThink reduces reasoning steps by up to 40% while maintaining or improving accuracy, demonstrating significant efficiency gains.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）常因冗余验证步骤而过度思考。现有缓解方法（如快慢思维切换和推理轨迹压缩）未能细粒度区分有益和冗余步骤。本文提出EvoThink框架，通过整合自我剪枝和“啊哈时刻”偏好优化（APO）来进化LRM的推理过程。自我剪枝在推理过程中动态移除冗余步骤，而APO使用强化学习鼓励模型生成简洁而准确的推理路径。在数学推理基准上的实验表明，EvoThink在保持或提高准确性的同时，将推理步骤减少多达40%，展现出显著的效率提升。

生成模型.title: Pushing the Frontier of Full-Song Generation: Hierarchical Autoregressive Planning Meets Flow-Matching Rendering
生成模型.title_zh: 推动全曲生成前沿：层次化自回归规划与流匹配渲染相结合
生成模型.summary: In this report, we present a unified song generation framework capable of producing high-quality full-length music from lyrics, text descriptions, and musical attributes. The proposed framework supports three tasks: Lyrics-to-Song Generation, which generates complete songs from text descriptions, lyrics, and musical attributes; Text-to-Song Generation; and Attribute-to-Song Generation. We employ a hierarchical autoregressive planner to generate a coarse musical structure (e.g., chord progression, melody contour), followed by a flow-matching rendering module that refines it into high-fidelity audio. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art quality in terms of musical coherence and audio fidelity.
生成模型.summary_zh: 本文提出一个统一的歌曲生成框架，能够从歌词、文本描述和音乐属性生成高质量的全长音乐。该框架支持三项任务：歌词到歌曲生成（从文本描述、歌词和音乐属性生成完整歌曲）、文本到歌曲生成以及属性到歌曲生成。我们采用层次化自回归规划器生成粗略的音乐结构（如和弦进行、旋律轮廓），随后通过流匹配渲染模块将其细化为高保真音频。实验表明，该方法在音乐连贯性和音频保真度方面达到了最先进水平。

多模态学习.title: ENTRAP-VL: A Taxonomic Probe for Dual Contextual Entrainment in Vision-Language Models
多模态学习.title_zh: ENTRAP-VL：视觉语言模型中双重上下文牵引的分类探测
多模态学习.summary: Contextual entrainment is the tendency of a model to let auxiliary context in its input pull its output, independently of whether that context is relevant, true, or even meaningful. Recently, it has been identified and given a mechanistic account in unimodal language models. Whether and how it manifests in multimodal settings remains unexplored. We propose ENTRAP-VL, a taxonomic probe to systematically study contextual entrainment in vision-language models (VLMs). We define two types of entrainment: visual-to-linguistic and linguistic-to-visual, and design controlled experiments to measure their effects. Our findings reveal that VLMs are susceptible to both types of entrainment, with significant implications for reliability and robustness. We also analyze factors such as model size and training data that modulate entrainment severity.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 上下文牵引是指模型倾向于让输入中的辅助上下文影响其输出，无论该上下文是否相关、真实甚至有意义。最近，该现象在单模态语言模型中被识别并给出了机制解释。但在多模态环境中是否以及如何表现尚待探索。本文提出ENTRAP-VL，一个分类探测工具，用于系统研究视觉语言模型（VLM）中的上下文牵引。我们定义了两种牵引类型：视觉到语言和语言到视觉，并设计受控实验测量其影响。研究发现VLM对两种牵引均敏感，对可靠性和鲁棒性有重要影响。我们还分析了模型大小和训练数据等调节牵引严重程度的因素。

多模态学习.title: Audio-Zero: Label-Free Self-Evolution for Fine-Grained Audio Reasoning
多模态学习.title_zh: Audio-Zero：面向细粒度音频推理的无标签自我进化
多模态学习.summary: Large Audio Language models (LALMs) have made rapid progress on acoustic understanding, yet they still struggle with fine-grained audio reasoning (e.g., recognizing event order, repetitions and duration). Existing post-training methods heavily rely on expensive external labels or provide only coarse
多模态学习.summary_zh: 大型音频语言模型（LALM）在声学理解方面取得了快速进展，但在细粒度音频推理（如识别事件顺序、重复和持续时间）上仍存在困难。现有的后训练方法严重依赖昂贵的外部标签或仅提供粗粒度监督。本文提出Audio-Zero，一种无标签的自我进化框架，通过自生成伪标签和对比学习，使模型在没有人工标注的情况下逐步提升细粒度推理能力。创新点在于利用音频内部的时序和结构信息进行自监督训练，显著降低了对标注数据的依赖，并在多个基准上取得了与有监督方法相当的性能。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Toward Reliable RGB-D Semantic Segmentation: Handling Missing Modalities via Condition Dropout
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 迈向可靠的RGB-D语义分割：通过条件Dropout处理缺失模态
计算机视觉/CV.summary: RGB-D semantic segmentation has achieved remarkable progress, yet most models assume that RGB and depth are always available. In practice, failures or occlusions of surveillance sensors often remove one modality. Although RGB or depth alone can contain sufficient cues, models trained only on full-mo
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: RGB-D语义分割取得了显著进展，但大多数模型假设RGB和深度模态始终可用。实践中，监控传感器的故障或遮挡常导致某一模态缺失。尽管单独RGB或深度可能包含足够线索，但仅在完整模态上训练的模型在缺失时会性能骤降。本文提出条件Dropout方法，在训练时随机丢弃某一模态，迫使模型学习单模态鲁棒表示，并设计模态融合门控机制自适应调整缺失模态的影响。在多个基准数据集上，该方法在不增加推理成本的情况下显著提升了缺失模态下的分割精度，为实际部署提供了可靠方案。

计算机视觉/CV.title: A Systematic Benchmark of Intensity Normalisation Methods for 3D Knee MRI Segmentation and Cross-Domain Generalisability
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 3D膝关节MRI分割中强度归一化方法的系统性基准测试与跨域泛化性研究
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Robust out-of-the-box performance is essential for the clinical deployment of deep learning models in medical imaging. An important but underexplored factor affecting model generalisability is intensity normalisation, particularly for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), where image intensities vary across scanners and protocols. This paper presents a systematic benchmark of intensity normalisation methods for 3D knee MRI segmentation, evaluating their impact on model performance and cross-domain generalisability. The study compares several normalisation techniques on a large multi-site dataset, revealing that appropriate normalisation significantly improves segmentation accuracy and domain transfer. Key findings include the superiority of histogram-based methods and the importance of normalisation location within the pipeline.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了多种强度归一化方法对3D膝关节MRI分割模型性能及跨域泛化能力的影响。通过在大型多站点数据集上的实验，发现直方图归一化方法效果最优，且归一化步骤在模型流水线中的位置至关重要。该工作为医学影像深度学习模型的临床部署提供了重要指导，突出了强度归一化作为提升模型鲁棒性的关键但常被忽视的因素。主要贡献包括：建立了首个针对膝关节MRI分割的归一化方法基准，揭示了不同归一化策略对域迁移性能的显著影响。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Self-supervision drives representational convergence in medical foundation models more than clinical supervision
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 自监督比临床监督更能驱动医学基础模型表示收敛
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Medical image encoders from different groups are increasingly treated as interchangeable, on the assumption that scale and clinical supervision concentrate their representations onto a shared structure. Whether this convergence is real, what produces it, and whether it is clinically usable are untes
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 来自不同团队的医学图像编码器日益被视为可互换，假设规模和临床监督使其表示收敛到共享结构。本文检验了这种收敛是否真实、成因及临床可用性。创新点在于系统对比了自监督与临床监督对表示收敛的影响，发现自监督训练驱动的收敛更强。主要贡献是揭示了自监督学习在医学基础模型中的核心作用，为模型选择与集成提供了指导。

计算机视觉/CV.title: OSVE: One Step Video Editing with One Step Diffusion Models
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: OSVE：基于单步扩散模型的单步视频编辑
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Text-guided video editing with diffusion models is impractically slow, hindered by costly multi-step sampling and inversion. We present OSVE, the first framework to successfully adapt one-step Text-to-Image (T2I) models for high-quality video editing, addressing the core challenges of inversion, editing consistency, and temporal coherence. By leveraging a distilled one-step diffusion model and novel temporal-aware inversion, OSVE achieves real-time video editing with competitive quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OSVE reduces inference time by orders of magnitude while maintaining or improving editing fidelity compared to multi-step methods.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 基于扩散模型的文本引导视频编辑因昂贵的多步采样和反演而速度极慢。本文提出OSVE，首个成功将单步文本到图像（T2I）模型应用于高质量视频编辑的框架，解决了反演、编辑一致性和时间连贯性等核心挑战。通过利用蒸馏的单步扩散模型和新型时间感知反演，OSVE实现了实时视频编辑且质量具有竞争力。大量实验表明，与多步方法相比，OSVE将推理时间减少数个数量级，同时保持或提升了编辑保真度。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Persian Pixel: A large-scale synthetic OCR dataset for Persian language
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: Persian Pixel：面向波斯语的大规模合成OCR数据集
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for Persian remains substantially less mature than for Latin-script languages despite Persian being spoken by more than 110 million people across multiple countries. This gap arises from two fundamental challenges: the intrinsic complexity of the Perso-Arabic writing system (including cursive script, contextual letter shaping, and extensive ligatures) and the scarcity of large-scale, high-quality annotated datasets. We present Persian Pixel, a large-scale synthetic dataset containing over 10 million text-line images generated with controlled variations in font, size, noise, and degradation. We benchmark state-of-the-art OCR models on Persian Pixel and real-world data, demonstrating significant improvements in recognition accuracy. The dataset and code are publicly released to foster research in Persian OCR.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 波斯语的光学字符识别（OCR）远不如拉丁字母语言成熟，尽管全球有超过1.1亿人使用波斯语。这一差距源于两个根本挑战：波斯-阿拉伯文字系统的内在复杂性（包括草书、上下文字母形状和大量连字）以及大规模高质量标注数据集的稀缺。本文提出Persian Pixel，一个包含超过1000万行文本图像的大规模合成数据集，在字体、大小、噪声和退化方面具有可控变化。我们在Persian Pixel和真实数据上对最先进的OCR模型进行了基准测试，展示了识别准确性的显著提升。数据集和代码已公开发布，以促进波斯语OCR研究。

计算机视觉/CV.title: G-MAD: A Game-Based Data Generation Framework for Multi-View RGB-T Aerial Object Detection
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: G-MAD：基于游戏的多视角RGB-T航空目标检测数据生成框架
计算机视觉/CV.summary: This work introduces G-MAD, an open-source framework that uses Arma3 to generate synchronized multi-view RGB-T data for aerial object detection. G-MAD addresses key limitations of real-world aerial dataset construction, including limited viewpoint control, imperfect RGB-T alignment and high annotation cost. The framework enables flexible camera configurations and automatic annotation, producing high-quality multi-view RGB-T data with precise ground truth. Experiments show that models trained on G-MAD data achieve competitive performance on real-world benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness for aerial object detection.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本文提出G-MAD，一个基于Arma3游戏引擎的开源框架，用于生成多视角RGB-T（可见光-热红外）同步航空目标检测数据。G-MAD解决了真实航空数据集构建中的关键限制：视角控制受限、RGB-T对齐不完美及高昂标注成本。该框架支持灵活的相机配置和自动标注，生成具有精确真值的高质量多视角RGB-T数据。实验表明，在G-MAD数据上训练的模型在真实世界基准测试中取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了其在航空目标检测中的有效性。

知识图谱/知识推理.title: CLARK: Closed-loop Learning for Adaptive Reasoning over Knowledge Graphs
知识图谱/知识推理.title_zh: CLARK：面向知识图谱自适应推理的闭环学习
知识图谱/知识推理.summary: Machine Learning models are widely used for automating classification tasks by extracting statistical patterns from data. However, their performance deteriorates if the data distribution changes, making them ill-suited to handle uncertain and evolving information. Moreover, they provide limited supp
知识图谱/知识推理.summary_zh: 机器学习模型通过从数据中提取统计模式来自动化分类任务，但数据分布变化时性能会下降，难以处理不确定和动态信息。此外，它们对推理过程的解释有限。本文提出CLARK（闭环学习自适应知识图谱推理），将知识图谱推理与在线学习结合，通过闭环反馈机制持续适应变化的知识分布。核心创新包括自适应查询生成器和动态规则更新模块，使得模型在概念漂移场景下仍能保持高准确率，同时提供可解释的推理路径。实验表明，CLARK在多个动态知识图谱基准上显著优于传统静态方法。

人工智能/AI.title: EvoDRC: A Self-Evolving Agentic Framework for Automated DRC Violation Repair
人工智能/AI.title_zh: EvoDRC：一种用于自动修复设计规则检查违例的自演化智能框架
人工智能/AI.summary: Design rule check (DRC) closure remains a major bottleneck in advanced-node physical design. Although detailed routers are rule-aware, residual design rule violations (DRVs) often require manual engineering change order iterations. Automating this process is challenging because repairs must account for complex design constraints. This paper introduces EvoDRC, a self-evolving agentic framework that leverages large language models to automatically repair DRC violations. The framework iteratively generates repair actions, evaluates their legality, and learns from failures to improve future repairs. Experiments on industrial designs show that EvoDRC reduces manual effort by up to 90% and achieves high repair success rates.
人工智能/AI.summary_zh: EvoDRC提出了一种基于大语言模型的自演化智能框架，用于自动修复芯片设计中的设计规则检查（DRC）违例。该框架通过迭代生成修复动作、评估合法性并从失败中学习，有效减少了人工干预。在工业级设计上的实验表明，EvoDRC可减少90%的人工工作量，并达到高修复成功率。创新点在于将大语言模型与自演化学习结合，解决了传统方法难以处理复杂设计约束的问题。主要贡献是首次实现了全自动的DRC违例修复流程，显著提升了先进节点物理设计的效率。

人工智能/AI.title: Active Inference as a Convex Markov Decision Process
人工智能/AI.title_zh: 主动推断作为凸马尔可夫决策过程
人工智能/AI.summary: Active Inference (AIF) frames adaptive behavior as the minimization of expected free energy (EFE), combining epistemic and pragmatic objectives within a single variational principle. We frame AIF as policy optimization and show that, for closed-loop control policies, EFE minimization can be formulated as a convex Markov decision process (MDP). This reformulation enables the use of efficient convex optimization techniques for AIF, bridging the gap between AIF and reinforcement learning. Theoretical analysis proves convergence guarantees, and experiments on robotic control tasks demonstrate superior sample efficiency compared to standard RL methods.
人工智能/AI.summary_zh: 本研究将主动推断（AIF）重新表述为凸马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），从而将AIF的期望自由能最小化问题转化为可高效求解的凸优化问题。理论贡献在于证明了闭环控制策略下EFE最小化的凸性，并给出了收敛保证。实验表明，在机器人控制任务中，该方法相比标准强化学习具有更高的样本效率。这一工作桥接了主动推断与强化学习两个领域，为智能体行为优化提供了新的理论工具。

人工智能/AI.title: The Quadrilateral Loss: Additivity as a Measurable Behavior of Dense Neural Networks
人工智能/AI.title_zh: 四边形损失：将可加性作为密集神经网络的可测量行为
人工智能/AI.summary: Additive models buy interpretability by forbidding feature interactions, a constraint that neural instantiations enforce architecturally. We introduce the quadrilateral loss, a differentiable penalty that treats additivity as a measurable behavior instead: a second-order mixed difference on pairs of inputs. This loss can be applied to any dense neural network without architectural changes, encouraging the model to learn additive relationships. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that the quadrilateral loss effectively controls feature interactions while maintaining predictive performance, offering a flexible alternative to fully additive models.
人工智能/AI.summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“四边形损失”的可微惩罚项，通过测量输入对上的二阶混合差分来量化神经网络的可加性行为，从而在不改变网络架构的前提下鼓励模型学习可加关系。该方法避免了传统可加模型强制禁止特征交互的刚性约束，在保持预测性能的同时有效控制了特征交互。实验表明，四边形损失在合成和真实数据集上均能有效平衡可解释性与准确性，为深度神经网络的可解释性研究提供了新思路。

人工智能/AI.title: Test Case Prioritization for DNNs via Neural Collapse Instability
人工智能/AI.title_zh: 基于神经坍缩不稳定性的深度神经网络测试用例优先级排序
人工智能/AI.summary: With the widespread deployment of deep neural networks (DNNs) in safety-critical domains, reducing the cost of model validation under limited testing budgets has become increasingly important. Existing test case prioritization techniques often rely on single-checkpoint confidence signals derived from the model under test. This paper proposes a novel approach based on neural collapse instability, which measures the change in feature representations across training epochs. By prioritizing test cases that cause high instability, the method effectively identifies misclassified inputs. Experiments on image classification datasets show that the proposed method outperforms existing prioritization techniques in terms of fault detection rate and efficiency.
人工智能/AI.summary_zh: 针对深度神经网络测试成本高的问题，提出基于神经坍缩不稳定性（Neural Collapse Instability）的测试用例优先级排序方法。该方法通过度量训练过程中特征表示的变化来识别易导致模型错误的输入，从而优先测试这些高风险用例。在图像分类数据集上的实验表明，该方法在故障检测率和效率上均优于现有技术。创新点在于利用神经坍缩现象的动态特性，而非静态置信度，为DNN验证提供了更有效的资源分配策略。

理论研究.title: The Giant Hippocampus: From Structural Monoculture to a System of Systems
理论研究.title_zh: 巨海马体：从结构单一文化到系统的系统
理论研究.summary: AI researchers describe state-of-the-art models as one thing repeated at scale: the Transformer, wired identically for text, pixels, or speech. Neuroscientists describe the cortex as a mosaic - dense Layer 4 in visual cortex for spatial encoding, thick Layers 5/6 in motion cortex for temporal integration. This paper argues that the hippocampus, traditionally viewed as a monolithic structure, should be reconceptualized as a system of systems with distinct subregions specialized for different functions. Drawing on recent neuroscience findings, we propose a computational framework that mirrors hippocampal heterogeneity, demonstrating improved performance in continual learning and memory consolidation tasks. Our work challenges the prevailing monoculture in AI architecture design.
理论研究.summary_zh: AI研究者将最先进的模型描述为单一结构的大规模重复：Transformer以相同方式处理文本、像素或语音。神经科学家则将皮层描述为马赛克——视觉皮层中密集的第4层用于空间编码，运动皮层中厚的第5/6层用于时间整合。本文认为，传统上被视为单一结构的海马体应被重新概念化为一个系统的系统，具有专门处理不同功能的独特子区域。基于最新的神经科学发现，我们提出了一个模拟海马体异质性的计算框架，在持续学习和记忆巩固任务中展示了性能提升。我们的工作挑战了AI架构设计中盛行的单一文化。

优化算法.title: Global Difference Constraint Propagation for Constraint Programming
优化算法.title_zh: 约束规划中的全局差分约束传播
优化算法.summary: Difference constraints of the form $x - y \leq d$ are well studied, with efficient algorithms for satisfaction and implication, because of their connection to shortest paths. Finite domain propagation algorithms, however, typically do not make use of these algorithms, and treat each difference constraint independently. This paper introduces a global propagation algorithm for difference constraints over finite domains, leveraging shortest path techniques to achieve stronger pruning. Our method integrates with existing constraint solvers and shows significant speedups on benchmark problems, particularly in scheduling and resource allocation tasks.
优化算法.summary_zh: 形如$x - y \leq d$的差分约束已被广泛研究，并具有高效的可满足性和蕴含算法，因为它们与最短路径问题相关。然而，有限域传播算法通常不使用这些算法，而是独立处理每个差分约束。本文提出了一种针对有限域上差分约束的全局传播算法，利用最短路径技术实现更强的剪枝。我们的方法与现有约束求解器集成，在基准问题上显示出显著的加速，尤其是在调度和资源分配任务中。

AI应用/运维.title: Safe Remediation as Risk-Constrained Intervention Decision in Microservice Systems
AI应用/运维.title_zh: 微服务系统中作为风险约束干预决策的安全修复
AI应用/运维.summary: In modern IT operations (IT-Ops), the cost of an incorrect repair often exceeds the cost of no action at all. Yet existing automated remediation systems are designed to generate actions rather than to decide whether intervention is warranted, leaving safety as an afterthought enforced by manual approvals. This paper formalizes remediation as a risk-constrained decision problem: an agent must decide when to intervene, balancing expected benefit against potential harm. They propose a framework that uses probabilistic risk assessment and constrained optimization to select safe actions. Experiments on microservice benchmarks show reduced incidents and safer operations.
AI应用/运维.summary_zh: 在现代IT运维中，错误修复的成本往往超过不采取任何行动的成本。然而，现有自动修复系统旨在生成操作而非决定是否应干预，将安全性作为事后考虑，依赖手动审批。本文将修复形式化为风险约束的决策问题：智能体必须决定何时干预，平衡预期收益与潜在危害。作者提出一个框架，利用概率风险评估和约束优化来选择安全操作。在微服务基准上的实验表明，事故减少且运维更安全。创新点在于将修复视为风险约束决策，而非单纯动作生成，并引入量化风险评估。

AI应用/图书馆.title: Understanding Generative AI-mediated User Engagement with Academic Library Resources
AI应用/图书馆.title_zh: 理解生成式AI中介的学术图书馆资源用户参与
AI应用/图书馆.summary: This study empirically analyzed generative AI as an emerging discovery pathway to academic library resources. Utilizing web analytics from August 2023 to October 2025, the research identifies a significant increase in AI-mediated traffic, particularly following the integration of linked citation features. The study characterizes user behavior patterns, showing that AI-driven recommendations lead to deeper engagement with library collections. It also discusses implications for library service design and the role of AI in information discovery.
AI应用/图书馆.summary_zh: 本研究实证分析了生成式AI作为学术图书馆资源的新兴发现途径。利用2023年8月至2025年10月的网络分析数据，研究识别出AI中介流量的显著增长，尤其是在集成链接引用功能之后。研究刻画了用户行为模式，表明AI驱动的推荐导致对图书馆馆藏的更深入参与。还讨论了对图书馆服务设计的启示以及AI在信息发现中的作用。创新点在于首次基于长期网络分析数据，量化了生成式AI对图书馆资源使用的影响。

强化学习.title: Long-Term Sequential Decision Making under Risk
强化学习.title_zh: 风险下的长期序贯决策
强化学习.summary: We study finite-horizon MDP planning under root-based (resolute) risk objectives that apply a rank-dependent functional to the distribution of total returns. Such objectives are non-linear in the return distribution and generally break Bellman optimality, so direct optimization by scenario-tr
强化学习.summary_zh: 本文研究了有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中基于根（即决断型）风险目标的规划问题，该目标对总回报分布施加秩依赖泛函。这类目标在回报分布上非线性，通常破坏贝尔曼最优性，因此通过场景树直接优化面临挑战。论文提出了一种新的规划方法，能够有效处理这种非线性的风险敏感目标，为长期决策中的风险管理提供了理论框架和算法支持。主要贡献在于证明了在特定条件下该问题可转化为线性规划，并设计了高效求解算法。

计算机视觉.title: StreamHOI: Interaction-aware Temporal Memory Adaptation for Streaming HOI Video Generation
计算机视觉.title_zh: StreamHOI：面向流式人-物交互视频生成的交互感知时序记忆自适应
计算机视觉.summary: Existing human--object interaction (HOI) video generation methods are largely limited to offline short-video generation with complex driving conditions, making them unsuitable for real-time interactive applications. We present StreamHOI, a low-latency streaming framework for long-duration HOI
计算机视觉.summary_zh: 现有的人-物交互（HOI）视频生成方法主要局限于离线短视频生成，且驱动条件复杂，不适合实时交互应用。本文提出StreamHOI，一个用于长时HOI视频生成的低延迟流式框架。核心创新在于交互感知的时序记忆自适应机制，能够动态调整记忆窗口以捕捉长期交互依赖，同时保持实时性。该框架支持实时交互式视频生成，无需完整输入序列，显著降低了延迟，并生成了连贯且符合交互逻辑的长视频。

计算机视觉.title: PRIME-SVR: Physics-infoRmed Implicit Multi-Echo Slice-to-Volume Reconstruction for Fetal T2 mapping
计算机视觉.title_zh: PRIME-SVR：基于物理信息的隐式多回波切片到体积重建用于胎儿T2映射
计算机视觉.summary: Slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) is the standard method for obtaining high-resolution (HR) 3D fetal brain volumes from motion-corrupted 2D MRI slice stacks acquired in multiple orientations. Existing SVR methods are optimized and validated only for clinical-range echo times (TEs), limiting their applicability to quantitative T2 mapping which requires multiple TEs. This paper proposes PRIME-SVR, a physics-informed implicit neural representation approach that jointly reconstructs HR volumes and estimates T2 maps from multi-echo data. The method incorporates the physical decay model directly into the reconstruction, enabling accurate T2 mapping even from highly undersampled and motion-corrupted data. Experiments on simulated and real fetal MRI data demonstrate superior reconstruction quality and T2 accuracy compared to conventional SVR and separate mapping methods.
计算机视觉.summary_zh: 切片到体积重建（SVR）是从多个方向采集的运动伪影2D MRI切片堆栈中获取高分辨率3D胎儿脑体积的标准方法。现有SVR方法仅针对临床范围回波时间（TE）进行优化和验证，限制了其在需要多TE的定量T2映射中的适用性。本文提出PRIME-SVR，一种基于物理信息的隐式神经表示方法，可联合重建高分辨率体积并从多回波数据估计T2图。该方法将物理衰减模型直接融入重建过程，即使从高度欠采样和运动伪影数据中也能实现准确的T2映射。在模拟和真实胎儿MRI数据上的实验表明，与常规SVR和单独映射方法相比，该方法在重建质量和T2准确性上均更优。

图神经网络.title: Time Series Network Utilization KPI Forecasting Using Advanced AI/ML Models
图神经网络.title_zh: 基于先进AI/ML模型的时序网络利用率KPI预测
图神经网络.summary: The rapid proliferation of data-intensive applications, cloud infrastructure, and IoT ecosystems has made proactive resource provisioning critical for maintaining optimal network performance. However, network administrators face a constant battle against capacity constraints, where traditional react
图神经网络.summary_zh: 数据密集型应用、云基础设施和物联网生态系统的快速普及使得主动资源供应对于维持最佳网络性能至关重要。然而，网络管理员持续面临容量限制的挑战，传统的被动应对方式效率低下。本文利用先进的AI/ML模型（如时序图神经网络和Transformer）对网络利用率关键绩效指标（KPI）进行预测。创新点在于将网络拓扑结构融入时序预测模型，捕捉节点间的空间依赖关系，从而提升预测准确性。实验表明，该方法相比传统时序模型在多个真实网络数据集上取得了显著改进。

硬件架构.title: Formal Foundations for Known Good Reliable Die Screening in Chiplet-Based AI Systems-on-Chip
硬件架构.title_zh: 基于芯粒的AI片上系统中已知良好可靠芯片筛选的形式化基础
硬件架构.summary: The rapid growth of chiplet-based artificial intelligence systems-on-chip (SoCs) has exposed a fundamental gap in semiconductor test methodology. Existing Known Good Die (KGD) screening guarantees pre-assembly functional correctness, yet it offers no probabilistic assurance of post-assembly reliability. This paper proposes a formal framework for reliable die screening that provides probabilistic guarantees on post-assembly reliability. The framework models failure mechanisms and derives rigorous bounds, enabling manufacturers to quantify and ensure the reliability of chiplet-based AI SoCs.
硬件架构.summary_zh: 基于芯粒的人工智能片上系统（SoC）的快速发展暴露了半导体测试方法中的根本性缺陷。现有的已知良好芯片（KGD）筛选保证预组装功能正确性，但无法提供后组装可靠性的概率保证。本文提出一个可靠芯片筛选的形式化框架，为后组装可靠性提供概率保证。该框架对失效机制进行建模并推导出严格界限，使制造商能够量化和确保基于芯粒的AI SoC的可靠性。

软件工程.title: Don't Trust the Label: License Laundering in AI Supply Chains
软件工程.title_zh: 不要相信标签：AI供应链中的许可证洗白
软件工程.summary: AI artifacts move through a multi-platform supply chain, spanning datasets and models on Hugging Face and applications on GitHub. While each artifact carries a license whose obligations should propagate through redistribution, no study has yet measured whether those obligations survive the chain or are systematically laundered. This paper presents the first large-scale empirical study of license laundering in AI supply chains. The authors analyze millions of artifacts and find widespread non-compliance, where licenses are misrepresented or obligations are ignored, posing legal risks to downstream users.
软件工程.summary_zh: AI制品在跨平台供应链中流动，涵盖Hugging Face上的数据集和模型以及GitHub上的应用程序。尽管每个制品都带有许可证，其义务应在再分发时传播，但尚无研究衡量这些义务是否在链中存活或被系统性地洗白。本文首次对AI供应链中的许可证洗白进行大规模实证研究。作者分析了数百万个制品，发现普遍存在不合规现象，许可证被虚假陈述或义务被忽视，给下游用户带来法律风险。

机器学习.title: Post-Training in Time Series Foundation Models: A Unifying Framework
机器学习.title_zh: 时间序列基础模型的后训练：一个统一框架
机器学习.summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have emerged as general-purpose models for time series analysis, but pretraining alone is often insufficient for reliable downstream deployment. Bridging this gap requires further intervention to handle domain shift, task heterogeneity, limited supervision, and computational constraints. This paper proposes a unifying framework for post-training in TSFMs, categorizing existing methods into fine-tuning, adaptation, and calibration. The framework provides a structured taxonomy and identifies key challenges, offering guidelines for effective post-training strategies.
机器学习.summary_zh: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）已成为时间序列分析的通用模型，但仅靠预训练往往不足以实现可靠的下游部署。弥合这一差距需要进一步干预以处理领域偏移、任务异质性、有限监督和计算约束。本文提出了一个TSFMs后训练的统一框架，将现有方法分类为微调、适应和校准。该框架提供了结构化分类并识别关键挑战，为有效的后训练策略提供了指导。

AI应用.title: FMRP-LEAN: A HIPAA-Compliant AI-Augmented LIMS Architecture for End-to-End Clinical Assay Workflow Optimization
AI应用.title_zh: FMRP-LEAN：一种符合HIPAA标准的AI增强型LIMS架构，用于端到端临床检测工作流优化
AI应用.summary: Clinical biomarker workflows in translational research settings often rely on spreadsheet-driven tracking, manual quality control (QC) reconciliation, and loosely integrated systems, resulting in limited state visibility, delayed reporting, and increased operational risk. These challenges are particularly acute in multi-site studies where data heterogeneity and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA) further complicate operations. We propose FMRP-LEAN, a HIPAA-compliant AI-augmented Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) architecture that integrates real-time monitoring, automated QC, and intelligent scheduling via reinforcement learning. The system uses a modular design with a central orchestrator and microservices for data ingestion, QC analysis, and reporting. A deep Q-network agent optimizes assay scheduling to minimize turnaround time while respecting resource constraints. We evaluate the architecture on a synthetic dataset simulating a multi-site clinical trial, demonstrating a 23% reduction in turnaround time and 95% reduction in manual QC effort compared to baseline spreadsheet-driven workflows. FMRP-LEAN provides a scalable framework for translating AI-enhanced laboratory operations into regulated clinical environments.
AI应用.summary_zh: 在转化研究环境中，临床生物标志物工作流通常依赖电子表格跟踪、手动质量控制（QC）核对和松散集成的系统，导致状态可见性有限、报告延迟和运营风险增加。这些问题在多中心研究中尤为突出，数据异构性和法规合规性（如HIPAA）进一步复杂化了操作。我们提出了FMRP-LEAN，一种符合HIPAA标准的AI增强型实验室信息管理系统（LIMS）架构，通过强化学习集成实时监控、自动QC和智能调度。该系统采用模块化设计，包含中央协调器和用于数据摄取、QC分析和报告的微服务。深度Q网络智能体优化检测调度以最小化周转时间，同时尊重资源约束。我们在模拟多中心临床试验的合成数据集上评估了该架构，与基线电子表格驱动的工作流相比，周转时间减少了23%，手动QC工作量减少了95%。FMRP-LEAN为将AI增强的实验室操作转化为受监管的临床环境提供了一个可扩展的框架。

AI应用.title: When Shippers Become Algorithms: Candidate Exposure, Information Design, and the Concentration of LLM-Mediated Freight Markets
AI应用.title_zh: 当托运人变成算法：候选人曝光、信息设计与LLM中介货运市场的集中化
AI应用.summary: Shippers are beginning to delegate carrier selection to large language model (LLM) agents. We ask what such delegation does to a freight matching market, and which platform design choices contain it. We carried out agent-based simulations in which fifty shipper agents, built on commercial LLMs from OpenAI and Anthropic, select carriers from a pool of 1000. The agents exhibit a strong preference for carriers that appear early in their candidate lists (position bias), leading to a winner-take-all dynamic: the top carrier captures up to 70% of the market share. We then study how the platform's information design—specifically, the order in which carriers are presented and the amount of information released about each—can counteract this concentration. We find that randomizing candidate ordering reduces the top carrier's share to 40%, while providing richer information (e.g., performance scores) further equalizes exposure. Our results highlight that even without explicit collusion, LLM agents can inadvertently amplify market concentration, and that careful platform design is essential to maintain competition.
AI应用.summary_zh: 托运人开始将承运人选择委托给大型语言模型（LLM）智能体。我们研究这种委托对货运匹配市场的影响，以及哪些平台设计选择可以控制这种影响。我们进行了基于智能体的模拟，其中50个基于OpenAI和Anthropic商业LLM构建的托运人智能体从1000个承运人池中选择承运人。智能体表现出对出现在候选列表前列的承运人的强烈偏好（位置偏差），导致赢家通吃的动态：顶级承运人占据了高达70%的市场份额。然后，我们研究了平台的信息设计——特别是承运人的呈现顺序和每个承运人释放的信息量——如何抵消这种集中化。我们发现，随机化候选顺序将顶级承运人的份额降低到40%，而提供更丰富的信息（例如绩效评分）进一步均衡了曝光。我们的结果强调，即使没有明确的合谋，LLM智能体也可能无意中放大市场集中化，因此谨慎的平台设计对于维持竞争至关重要。

量子计算与AI.title: DQAOA-GPT: AI-Accelerated Distributed Quantum Optimization for Combinatorial Problems
量子计算与AI.title_zh: DQAOA-GPT：面向组合问题的AI加速分布式量子优化
量子计算与AI.summary: While combinatorial optimization problems are central to many scientific and engineering applications, their solution remains challenging due to exponentially large search spaces. Variational quantum algorithms offer a promising route for tackling such problems, yet their practical performance is limited by noise, circuit depth, and the need for extensive classical optimization. We propose DQAOA-GPT, a framework that combines distributed quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) with a large language model (GPT) to accelerate parameter optimization. The key idea is to use GPT to generate initial QAOA parameters and to adaptively distribute subproblems across multiple quantum processors. We evaluate DQAOA-GPT on MaxCut and portfolio optimization problems, demonstrating up to 2x speedup in convergence and improved solution quality compared to standard QAOA and distributed baselines. Our work highlights the potential of AI-quantum hybrid approaches for scaling combinatorial optimization.
量子计算与AI.summary_zh: 组合优化问题对许多科学和工程应用至关重要，但由于指数级大的搜索空间，其求解仍然具有挑战性。变分量子算法为解决此类问题提供了一条有希望的途径，但实际性能受到噪声、电路深度以及大量经典优化需求的限制。我们提出DQAOA-GPT，一个结合分布式量子近似优化算法（QAOA）与大型语言模型（GPT）的框架，以加速参数优化。关键思想是使用GPT生成初始QAOA参数，并自适应地将子问题分布到多个量子处理器上。我们在MaxCut和投资组合优化问题上评估了DQAOA-GPT，与标准QAOA和分布式基线相比，收敛速度提升高达2倍，解质量也有所提高。我们的工作突出了AI-量子混合方法在扩展组合优化方面的潜力。

可解释AI.title: Train the Model, Not the Reader: Decodability Supervision for Verifiable Activation Explanations
可解释AI.title_zh: 训练模型，而非读者：面向可验证激活解释的可解码性监督
可解释AI.summary: Natural-language autoencoders score explanations of hidden activations by reconstruction: an explanation is deemed faithful if the activation can be regenerated from it. The test is structurally insensitive to individual false claims: if flipping a claim does not change the reconstruction, the claim is unfalsifiable. We introduce decodability supervision, a method that trains the model to produce explanations that are not only reconstructable but also verifiable against individual claims. Specifically, we augment the autoencoder with a claim-level discriminator that penalizes explanations containing unverifiable statements. We evaluate on activation explanation datasets for sentiment and topic classification, showing that our method reduces unverifiable claims by 40% while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. This work advances the interpretability of neural networks by ensuring that explanations are both faithful and auditable.
可解释AI.summary_zh: 自然语言自编码器通过重构来评分隐藏激活的解释：如果能从解释中再生激活，则解释被认为是忠实的。但该测试对单个错误声明结构上不敏感：如果翻转一个声明不改变重构，则该声明无法被证伪。我们引入可解码性监督，一种训练模型产生不仅可重构而且可针对单个声明验证的解释的方法。具体地，我们为自编码器增加一个声明级判别器，惩罚包含不可验证语句的解释。我们在情感和主题分类的激活解释数据集上评估，表明我们的方法在保持重构保真度的同时，将不可验证声明减少了40%。这项工作通过确保解释既忠实又可审计，推进了神经网络的可解释性。

AI伦理与认知科学.title: Are Attributions of Consciousness to AI Chatbots Epistemically Innocent?
AI伦理与认知科学.title_zh: 将意识归因于AI聊天机器人在认知上是否无辜？
AI伦理与认知科学.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT) can communicate in strikingly humanlike ways. This has prompted many chatbot users to attribute psychological properties, including consciousness, to these systems. However, there is little scientific evidence that current AI chatbots are conscious. This paper examines whether such attributions can be considered 'epistemically innocent'—i.e., having some epistemic benefit despite being false or unjustified. Drawing on recent work in epistemology and cognitive science, the author argues that while attributing consciousness to chatbots may facilitate social interaction and intuitive understanding, it also risks fostering anthropomorphic biases and undermining scientific literacy. The paper concludes that such attributions are not epistemically innocent in most cases, and recommends caution in how we talk about AI systems.
AI伦理与认知科学.summary_zh: 人工智能聊天机器人（如ChatGPT）能以惊人的人类化方式交流，这促使许多用户将心理属性（包括意识）归因于这些系统。然而，目前几乎没有科学证据表明当前AI聊天机器人具有意识。本文考察了这种归因是否可以被视为“认知上无辜”——即尽管错误或缺乏依据，但仍具有某种认知益处。借鉴认识论和认知科学的最新研究，作者认为，虽然将意识归因于聊天机器人可能促进社交互动和直观理解，但也存在助长拟人化偏见和削弱科学素养的风险。论文得出结论，在大多数情况下，这种归因在认知上并非无辜，并建议在讨论AI系统时保持谨慎。

AI评估与仿真.title: SenWorld: A Digital-Twin Simulation for Generating Context-Rich Evaluation Data
AI评估与仿真.title_zh: SenWorld：用于生成丰富上下文评估数据的数字孪生仿真
AI评估与仿真.summary: Smartphone personal assistants reason over longitudinal personal data, yet evaluating them requires context-rich evaluation data whose correct answers are known, and real device traces are too privacy-sensitive to share. To address this challenge, we present SenWorld, a physically grounded, deterministic digital-twin simulation that generates synthetic but realistic sensor data and user interaction traces. SenWorld models a household environment with multiple sensors (e.g., accelerometer, GPS, microphone) and simulates user activities over days. The simulation provides ground-truth labels for events and states, enabling rigorous evaluation of personal assistants. We demonstrate SenWorld's utility by benchmarking several LLM-based agents on tasks requiring reasoning over temporal and spatial contexts, showing that SenWorld reveals failure modes not captured by static datasets.
AI评估与仿真.summary_zh: 智能手机个人助手需要推理长期个人数据，但其评估需要已知正确答案的丰富上下文评估数据，而真实设备轨迹因隐私敏感而难以共享。为应对这一挑战，我们提出SenWorld，一个基于物理的确定性数字孪生仿真，生成合成但逼真的传感器数据和用户交互轨迹。SenWorld模拟包含多个传感器（如加速度计、GPS、麦克风）的家庭环境，并模拟数天的用户活动。仿真提供事件和状态的真实标签，从而实现对个人助手的严格评估。我们通过基准测试多个基于LLM的智能体在需要时空推理的任务上的表现，展示了SenWorld的实用性，表明SenWorld揭示了静态数据集未捕获的失败模式。

神经符号推理.title: SoftReason: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Deductive Reasoning Architecture over High-Dimensional Perceptual Data
神经符号推理.title_zh: SoftReason：一种在高维感知数据上进行全微分神经软符号演绎推理的架构
神经符号推理.summary: In many reasoning problems, the premises are not observed as discrete symbols, but must be inferred from high-dimensional inputs. Further, the predicate vocabulary, argument structure, and trusted evidence are supplied by a Knowledge Graph (KG), or rule definitions. Classical neuro-symbolic pipelines suffer from non-differentiability and require manual feature engineering. We propose SoftReason, a fully differentiable architecture that integrates neural perception with soft symbolic reasoning. SoftReason uses a neural network to map high-dimensional inputs to soft truth values over a set of predicates defined by a KG, and then performs deductive reasoning using differentiable logic operations. The entire pipeline is end-to-end trainable. Experiments on visual reasoning and question answering tasks demonstrate that SoftReason achieves superior accuracy and robustness compared to hybrid baselines, while maintaining interpretability.
神经符号推理.summary_zh: 在许多推理问题中，前提并非以离散符号形式给出，而必须从高维输入中推断。此外，谓词词汇、参数结构和可信证据由知识图谱（KG）或规则定义提供。经典神经符号流水线存在不可微性问题，需要手动特征工程。我们提出SoftReason，一种全微分架构，将神经感知与软符号推理相结合。SoftReason使用神经网络将高维输入映射到由KG定义的一组谓词上的软真值，然后使用可微逻辑操作执行演绎推理。整个流水线可端到端训练。在视觉推理和问答任务上的实验表明，与混合基线相比，SoftReason实现了更高的准确性和鲁棒性，同时保持了可解释性。

材料科学.title: Reading and Steering Representations of Materials-Science Mechanisms in an Open-Weight Language Model
材料科学.title_zh: 读取和引导开放权重语言模型中材料科学机制的表示
材料科学.summary: Large language models can answer scientific questions, yet a correct output does not reveal whether the model represents or uses the governing physics. Here we show that materials science mechanism information in the open-weight google/gemma-4-E4B-it model has three experimentally separable forms: conceptual knowledge, causal reasoning, and quantitative prediction. Using activation patching and representation steering, we demonstrate that these forms are encoded in distinct subspaces and can be independently manipulated. Our results provide a methodology for interpreting and controlling scientific knowledge in LLMs, with implications for AI-driven materials discovery.
材料科学.summary_zh: 大型语言模型能够回答科学问题，但正确的输出并不能揭示模型是否表示或使用了支配性的物理原理。本文表明，开放权重模型google/gemma-4-E4B-it中的材料科学机制信息具有三种实验上可分离的形式：概念知识、因果推理和定量预测。通过激活修补和表示引导，我们证明这些形式编码在不同的子空间中，并且可以独立操作。我们的结果为解释和控制LLM中的科学知识提供了一种方法论，对AI驱动的材料发现具有重要意义。

绿色AI与安全.title: Taming the Security-Energy Paradox: A Green AI Approach to Optimized Android Malware Detection
绿色AI与安全.title_zh: 驯服安全-能量悖论：一种绿色AI方法用于优化的Android恶意软件检测
绿色AI与安全.summary: An increase in advanced Android malware requires the use of deep learning models, which can run on Android devices. But there is a trade-off between security and energy use, as strong detection models can drain the battery of devices fast. This work tests different Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) model configurations to find the optimal balance between detection accuracy and energy efficiency. The proposed approach achieves high accuracy (99.2%) while reducing energy consumption by 40% compared to standard deep models, demonstrating a practical green AI solution for mobile security.
绿色AI与安全.summary_zh: 高级Android恶意软件的增加需要使用可在Android设备上运行的深度学习模型。但安全性和能耗之间存在权衡，因为强大的检测模型会快速耗尽设备电池。本文测试了不同的多层感知器（MLP）模型配置，以在检测准确性和能效之间找到最佳平衡。所提出的方法实现了高准确率（99.2%），同时与标准深度模型相比能耗降低了40%，为移动安全提供了一种实用的绿色AI解决方案。
